# `.vpl` spec check (generated)

Generated by `VP_REGEN_LEX_FIXTURES=1 vp_tests -tc='lex: committed fixtures*'` from the reference encoder
`engine/tests/lex_fixture_writer.cpp` (DESIGN.md §5). The Python packer (`tools/build_library/pack.py`) should
reproduce these offsets for the same input; with the STRS convention below it can reproduce the bytes.

Header fields are packed in the order of §5: magic @0, major u16 @4, minor u16 @6, lang char[8] @8,
section_count u32 @16, file_size u64 @20 (unaligned), sha256 u8[32] @28 (of bytes [256, file_size)), zeros
to 256. Section table @256: 24-byte entries {char[4] tag, u32 reserved=0, u64 offset, u64 length}, in file
order. Each section starts 8-byte aligned (zero gap before it); `length` is unpadded; the file ends at the end
of the last section. STRS: a NUL at offset 0 (empty string; "none" fields such as emoji_off are 0), then
every distinct non-empty string sorted bytewise, each NUL-terminated. FEAT: every packed word used by ANAL or
GENX, ascending (feat_id = index). KEYS keys and REVX keywords sorted bytewise; ANAL grouped by key; GENX
sorted by feat_id inside each lemma; CAND sorted by score desc, lemma id asc, sense asc.
